lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: دَافِقٍ is in the derivative form: دَافِقٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/ف/ق   d–f–q to gush forth; (of a valley) to fill up with flood water, (of a river) to breach its banks; to stampede; to act rashly. Of this root, دَافِقٌ dāfiq occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دَافِقٌ dāfiq [act. part.] gushing forth, jetting out, spurting ‏

(86:6) خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ He is created from gushing fluid.
